title: Standard Chartered Super Value Titanium credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Super Value Titanium card providing cashback on fuel, groceries, and bill payments, surcharge waivers at fuel stations, and milestone vouchers for everyday essential spenders.

benefitRows.name: Priority Pass
benefitRows.howToAvail: Visit the Priority Pass activation page. Enter your membership number and validation code. If required, provide the last four digits of your payment card associated with the membership
